(vp.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%') OR vp.sub_title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{q.keyword},'%'))

SELECT candidates.*, (100 + 100*LN(1+total_sold) + 20*((COALESCE(score,0)/10.0*COALESCE(comments,0)+35)/(COALESCE(comments,0)+10))) * CASE WHEN #{q.districtCode} IS NOT NULL AND district_code=#{q.districtCode} THEN 1.15 ELSE 1 END * CASE WHEN distance IS NOT NULL THEN 1/(1+distance/3000) ELSE 1 END AS recommended_score FROM (SELECT s.*, root.id AS category_id, root.name AS category_name, t.name AS type_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(v.sold_count) FROM voucher_product v WHERE v.shop_id=s.id),0) AS total_sold, AS distance ) candidates
ORDER BY distance IS NULL, distance ASC, id ASC ORDER BY total_sold DESC, id ASC ORDER BY score DESC, id ASC ORDER BY recommended_score DESC, id ASC LIMIT #{q.size} OFFSET #{q.offset}

SELECT ranked.* FROM (SELECT vp.id, vp.shop_id, vp.title, vp.product_type, vp.price_amount, vp.market_amount, vp.total_use_count, vp.sold_count, COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY vp.shop_id) AS available_count, CASE WHEN #{q.keyword} IS NOT NULL AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS keyword_matched, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY vp.shop_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{q.keyword} IS NOT NULL AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, vp.sold_count DESC, vp.price_amount ASC, vp.id ASC) AS hot_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY vp.shop_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN #{q.keyword} IS NOT NULL AND THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, vp.price_amount ASC, vp.sold_count DESC, vp.id ASC) AS cheap_rank FROM voucher_product vp JOIN shop s ON s.id=vp.shop_id WHERE s.status='ACTIVE' AND AND vp.shop_id IN #{id} ) ranked WHERE hot_rank <= 2 OR cheap_rank <= 2
